title: mcp
description: The Wikipedia of AI prompts: search 900+ curated prompts by model, style and type, in 7 languages
summary: The Wikipedia of AI prompts: search 900+ curated prompts by model, style and type, in 7 languages
offersHint: The Wikipedia of AI prompts: search 900+ curated prompts by model, style and type, in 7 languages · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.wikiprompt.org/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_prompts
toolsPreview.description: Search the Wikiprompt catalog of 900+ curated AI prompts. All filters combine. Returns compact rows with the canonical URL; call get_prompt with a slug for the full prompt text.

toolsPreview.name: get_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one prompt in full by slug (or UUID): complete prompt text, structured metadata (model, prompt type, style, quality assessment), author, media and source attribution. Optional locale (es, pt, fr, zh, de, ja) returns the translated version.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List the 9 Wikiprompt categories with live prompt counts.

toolsPreview.name: list_facets
toolsPreview.description: List the searchable facet values with counts: AI models/tools, visual styles, and prompt types. Use these values in search_prompts filters.

toolsPreview.name: get_featured
toolsPreview.description: Get the editor-featured prompts (the best of the catalog).

toolsPreview.name: get_trending
toolsPreview.description: Get prompts trending right now (1000+ views in the last 7 days). May be empty when nothing crosses the threshold.

toolsPreview.name: get_recent
toolsPreview.description: Get the most recently added prompts, optionally filtered by category.

toolsPreview.name: random_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Get one random prompt from the catalog, optionally within a category.

toolsPreview.name: get_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get catalog statistics: total prompts, contributors, and the media/type breakdown.

toolsPreview.name: get_prompt_translations
toolsPreview.description: List the available translations of a prompt (locale + translated title).

toolsPreview.name: prompts_by_author
toolsPreview.description: List prompts contributed by a specific author handle (as shown on prompt pages).

toolsPreview.name: submit_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Submit a new prompt to Wikiprompt. Requires a wikiprompt API key (create one from your profile at wikiprompt.org). Pass it as the api_key argument or send an Authorization: Bearer header.
